description: This file contains the implementation of the AssumeRoleCredentialProvider class, which provides AWS credentials by assuming a specified IAM role using the AWS SDK for PHP. It manages the configuration and invocation of the assumeRole operation via an STS client and handles credential retrieval asynchronously with error handling.

classes.name: AssumeRoleCredentialProvider
classes.description: Provides AWS credentials by assuming a role using the AWS SDK's STS client, supporting asynchronous credential retrieval and error handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the provider with configuration options including the STS client and assume role parameters.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Loads the assume role credentials asynchronously, returning a promise, and handles exceptions related to credential retrieval.
